name: toast
title: Toast
description: A brief message over the page that can leave by itself.
use: A confirmation of something that just happened: saved, deployed, copied. A reader must be able to miss it without losing anything, so the only way to an action never lives in a toast. Toasts stack in one toast-region per page, and each toast is a non-modal dialog.

instead.when: The message must stay until it is dealt with, or belongs to one part of the page
It is news for everyone on the page and stays across its top
It needs an answer before the reader goes on
It reports work that is still under way

platform.feature: A dialog with the open attribute, dismissed by a form with method="dialog" or a button with commandfor and command="close"
platform.fallback: A toast rendered with open is shown and dismissed without script. To show one after the page has loaded, call show() on it or append a new dialog with open to the region
The toast appears and leaves at once, without the fade

platform.feature: popover="manual" on the region, shown once with showPopover()
platform.fallback: Without it the region is a fixed element with a z-index and stays under an open modal dialog

classes.name: toast-region
classes.description: The fixed stack at the bottom, at the end edge, with the newest toast last. Make it a live region with aria-live="polite" and name it with aria-label. It takes no pointer events itself, and spans the width on a narrow screen

classes.name: toast-region-top
classes.description: The stack at the top; toasts arrive downward and the newest is on top

classes.name: toast-region-center
classes.description: The stack centered instead of at the end edge; it combines with toast-region-top

classes.name: toast
classes.description: A message, on a dialog element inside the region, named with aria-labelledby pointing at its title or with aria-label

classes.name: toast-timed
classes.description: Leaves by itself after --toast-duration. The clock pauses while the toast is hovered or holds focus, and a hairline along its foot runs out with the clock

classes.name: toast-info
classes.description: Colors the icon with the info hue; the words stay in ink

classes.name: toast-success
classes.description: Colors the icon with the success hue; the words stay in ink

classes.name: toast-warning
classes.description: Colors the icon with the warning hue; the words stay in ink

classes.name: toast-danger
classes.description: Colors the icon with the danger hue; the words stay in ink

classes.name: toast-icon
classes.description: Beside icon on the status icon: centers it on the first line of text

classes.name: toast-body
classes.description: Holds the words and takes the remaining width; a button after it sits at the end of the row

classes.name: toast-title
classes.description: The few strong words that say what happened

classes.name: toast-description
classes.description: A quiet sentence under the title, or the whole message of a toast without a title

classes.name: toast-close
classes.description: The form with method="dialog", or the button, that dismisses the toast, pulled into the padding at the end

states.name: open
states.description: The toast is shown. Written in markup it shows the toast when the page loads; show() and close() set and remove it

properties.name: --toast-duration
properties.description: How long a toast-timed stays; 6s when not set

properties.name: --toast-inset
properties.description: Distance of the region from the viewport edge
